name: Overtime Factory
text: Whenever you win a trick after you've taken your bid, gain +20 gold.

signature.trigger: you win a trick after taking your bid

archetypes: Contract Attacker, Spade Master, High Card; splash Gold Miner
decision: Whether an overtrick is worth its bag: early the gold buys more than a bag costs; late, the bag costs more than the gold can buy.
opponent: Visible; the bag counts toward your team's penalty.
aiNote: Take overtricks freely while your team has fewer than five bags.
rationale: A strong seat takes about one overtrick a round, so it pays about 15 to 20 gold a round, the common economy rate, and the bags it invites make it weaker late.
deviation: Redesigned from an ace-affinity optional bag for gold, so it pays on any overtrick instead of on a fixed card.
